\begin{itemize}\setlength{\itemsep}{2pt}
  \item \textbf{SHAP stability under forward-time validation} (Diaconu \& Pele, 2026, submitted to Expert Systems with Applications): on IEEE-CIS, graph features shift SHAP distributions slightly more than a Gaussian control (+0.00534 nats) and change the leading field on 44.2\,\% of later payments.
  \item Our replication on Elliptic (8 refits): graph minus Gaussian JS 0.0139 nats; the graph block takes 56\,\% of the SHAP mass (Gaussian: 10\,\%).
  \item The leading reason of a later transaction differs from the tabular model's for 54\,\% of cases with graph features vs 20\,\% with Gaussian ones; after the dark-market shutdown recall falls to 0.02.
  \item Decision: monitor explanations with a matched control and on the reasons shown to investigators, not on one distance alone.
\end{itemize}
